'''O'reen''' was an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a surface featuring thick fog and tall mesas and plateaus. It was inhabited by the [[near-Human]] [[O'reenian]]s. The planet was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] advance warning outpost, based on a self-sufficient military [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. Eventually, the colonists were stranded and isolated from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Following a [[Coup on O'reen|coup]] led by [[Magnus (starship captain)|Magnus]], the colony's military leader, O'reenian society transformed itself into a caste-based military [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]] devoted to the planet's military buildup under the rule of a leader holding the title of [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]]. Only those who served with O'reen's military were granted full citizenship and rights.

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] after O'reen's settlement, the [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]] captured a [[Unidentified corporate exploration vessel|corporate exploration vessel]] that had discovered their world. The encounter made the O'reenians realize how backward their level of technology had become compared to that of the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. In an attempt to counter that, the [[O'reen Star Corps]] performed raids on nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to capture modern military technology. [[Thief/Legends|Stolen]] equipment was then analyzed on O'reen in order to upgrade the planet's own armaments. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the planet was visited by offworlders on several occasions.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], O'reen's natives captured the crew of a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|Republic military exploration ship]], resulting in a [[Rescue on O'reen|rescue operation]] on the planet, followed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] placing the hostile world under a quarantine that lasted for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]. At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|disestablishment]] of the Republic, the O'reenians stole a prototype [[tactical data core]] from a galactic-scale [[Navy/Legends|naval]] force, planning to install it aboard a refurbished [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]]. A group of individuals tasked to retrieve the tactical [[Datacore/Legends|computer]] traveled to O'reen. There, the group infiltrated the [[Orbital Deployment Center]] [[garrison-city]] and [[Skirmish in the Orbital Deployment Center analysis station|stole]] the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] from an [[Unidentified analysis station|analysis station]] before escaping the planet. As the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, O'reen once again became virtually forgotten; however, the [[Unidentified Magnus (Yuuzhan Vong War)|ruling Magnus]] continued to wait for an opportunity to expand the planet's influence.

==Description==
O'reen was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> in the [[O'reen system/Legends|O'reen system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> located just inside the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] border with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] equal to 1.1 standard. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on O'reen lasted 355 [[Local day/Legends|local days]] while a day was thirty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long.<ref name="TUR" />

The climate on O'reen was [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]]. A thick, perpetual fog covered much of the terrestrial planet's surface and was punctured by towering mesas and plateaus. A [[Species/Legends|species]] of flying creatures lived on O'reen.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
===A Republic origin===
====Colonization of O'reen====
O'reen was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] shortly following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="TUR" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] founded several advance warning outposts past the boundaries of known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] against a perceived [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] threat. The outposts would have served as military [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] as well as self-sustaining colonies. The outpost on O'reen was led by the [[Unidentified Republic bureaucrat's son|son]] of a Republic [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]], while the colony's military was headed by [[Magnus (starship captain)|Magnus]], a former [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. During the colonization of O'reen, numerous [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] were put in the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to serve as an early warning system.<ref name="TUR" />

[[File:Great_Hyperspace_War.jpg|thumb|left|250px|O'reen was settled in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace War.]]
When the other outposts failed due to various reasons, the Republic scrapped the entire project, leaving [[O'reenian]] colonists stranded and isolated from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Seeing the colony as doomed if strict discipline was not established, Magnus overthrew the unpopular leader of the colonists in a quick and bloodless [[Coup on O'reen|coup]].<ref name="TUR" />

Within a year, a military [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]] had been established on O'reen, with the colony becoming a self-sufficient and well-disciplined military outpost. Magnus's coup, as well as the abundance of natural resources on the planet, allowed the colony to flourish, and Magnus's surname eventually became honored as the [[Magnus (title)|title]] of the outpost's leader. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] after O'reen's settlement, the original purpose of the Republic colony became nearly forgotten, and the society stratified into a caste system based on martial prowess and maintaining the military readiness of the outpost.<ref name="TUR" />

====Renewed contact with the galaxy====
Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TUR" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a [[Unidentified corporate exploration vessel|corporate exploration vessel]] accidentally discovered O'reen. The [[Scout ship/Legends|starship's]] [[Unidentified captain (corporate exploration vessel)|captain]] attempted to display the technological superiority of his spacecraft in order to impress the O'reenians. The captain also intended to claim the world for his corporate employers; however, the O'reen military forces, underestimated by the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], defeated the vessel.<ref name="TUR" />

The encounter served to inform the inhabitants of O'reen of how far their level of technology had fallen behind that of the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The [[Unidentified Magnus (scout encounter)|ruling Magnus]] decreed that the scout starship be repaired and retrofitted. The [[O'reen Star Corps]] was also eventually established, which, for the following centuries, performed carefully planned raids on the nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in order to acquire new military technology, allowing the O'reen military to try and catch up to the galactic levels of combat technology.<ref name="TUR" />

====Accidental visitors====
{{RPGseed}}
At some point during that [[Time/Legends|time]], an error in trajectory calculations forced a traveling starship to revert out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], causing the vessel to become sufficiently damaged to require a rough landing on the nearby O'reen. After learning via simple long-range [[Sensor/Legends|scan]] that their starship was being tracked by numerous orbital emplacements, the ship's crew&mdash;through a mix of skill and luck&mdash;landed their craft away from the planet's larger [[Garrison-city|garrison-cities]].<ref name="TUR" />

The crew avoided capture by a local patrol, but their damaged ship was taken to the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as the [[Orbital Deployment Center]]. Subsequently, the individuals broke into the heavily guarded city, in the process avoiding getting involved in a [[Lightfight|shootout]]. The crew stole back their ship plus the necessary repair parts, fixed the vessel, and left O'reen. After jumping to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], the crew discovered that several O'reenians had sneaked aboard the ship. The stowaways then attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the crew and return the vessel to O'reen.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

====A traitor's shipment====
{{RPGseed}}
On another occasion, an [[Unidentified O'reenian weapons smuggler|O'reenian]] hired the crew of a starship to transport a large cargo of undisclosed luxury goods to a [[Unidentified O'reenian contact|contact]] on O'reen. While underway, the crew opened the storage containers, only to discover that the cargo was in reality a large amount of military-grade [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and weapons. The crew then decided to proceed with the delivery of the cargo anyway, despite not having the appropriate permits for transporting such equipment.<ref name="TUR" />

Arriving near the planet, the starship was hailed by O'reen ground control, which threatened to have the vessel shot down unless it transmitted the proper identification codes. The ship's crew negotiated for the right to land on O'reen. On the planet, O'reenians boarded and inspected the starship, confiscating the military equipment as evidence of a [[Treason/Legends|traitorous]] plot against the ruling Magnus. The crew then had to lead the O'reenians to their contact before the group was allowed to leave the planet.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

===Return to obscurity===
====Clone Wars====
[[File:PhaseICloneTrooper1-Fathead.png|thumb|right|200px|Republic clone troopers performed a rescue operation on O'reen.]]
During the Clone Wars, a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|Republic military exploration ship]] was investigating nearby [[Star/Legends|star]] systems in search of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] supply depots. The vessel discovered O'reen, but its captain's lack of training in protocol concerning first contact resulted in a misunderstanding that led to violence, and the majority of the ship's crew was captured and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]] led [[Vornskr Company]] of the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in a [[Rescue on O'reen|rescue]] of the crew, which resulted in the death of the [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars rescue)|reigning Magnus]].<ref name="TUR" />

The deceased Magnus's [[Unidentified Magnus (post-Clone Wars rescue)|successor]] was unwilling to risk another military intervention by the Republic. Nevertheless, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] decided to quarantine O'reen in order to both contain the inhabitants' hostility and prevent the Separatists from gaining resources and military knowledge from the planet.<ref name="TUR" />

====O'reen and the Republic's successors====
The quarantine of O'reen outlasted<ref name="TUR" /> the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], as well as the Empire's own [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fragmentation]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and eventual [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|supplantation]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NEC" /> When the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy<ref name="TUR" /> in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Unidentified Magnus (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Magnus]] decided to maintain a careful and observant attitude toward the invaders.<ref name="TUR" />

[[27 ABY/Legends|Two years]] later, the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] the New Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="NEC" /> and, during the devastation that followed the battle, all the recorded information on O'reen stored on the planet was lost. Subsequently, the Magnus continued to observe the galactic events, seeking the right opportunity to expand their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] influence in the surrounding region.<ref name="TUR" />

====Aftermath of a raid====
{{RPG|"[[A Fool's Charge]]"}}
=====Tracking down the thieves=====
[[File:OreenAnalysisStation.png|thumb|left|230px|A group of individuals retrieved a stolen tactical computer from an analysis center on O'reen.]]
As part of a supply acquisition raid at some point after the disestablishment of the Galactic Republic, the O'reen Star Corps attacked a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] starship affiliated with a galactic-scale [[Navy/Legends|navy]] in the Outer Rim Territories, near the region's border with the Unknown Regions. The Star Corps [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the ship's cargo, a prototype [[tactical data core]] of a [[Command ship/Legends|command]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. The [[Datacore/Legends|data core]], along with other military equipment acquired in the raid, was brought back to O'reen and held in an [[Unidentified analysis station|analysis station]] in the Orbital Deployment Center. There, the [[Tactical computer/Legends|tactical computer]] was studied by a group of O'reenian [[Scientist/Legends|researchers]], led by a [[Unidentified O'reenian military supervisor|military supervisor]], for potential installation in a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] being refurbished in O'reen's orbit, and it was eventually scheduled to be transferred to [[Fort Maximus]],<ref name="Fool" /> the planet's capital.<ref name="TUR" />

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Amalia]], an [[Aide/Legends|attendant]] of a [[Military rank/Legends|high-ranking]] naval [[Officer/Legends|officer]] interested in retrieving the [[Computer/Legends|computer]], hired a group of individuals to return the stolen equipment. Traveling to the provided coordinates where the transport was attacked, the group followed Amalia's suggestion and looked through both archived and recent [[Star map/Legends|astrogation charts]] of the area to find any indication of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] establishing bases in the nearby systems. The individuals discovered evidence of the supposedly abandoned O'reen colony, although its exact location had been lost by that time.<ref name="Fool" />

The sensors of the group's starship then detected an archaic transmission broadcast from one of nearby O'reen's early warning satellites. Several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] later, a pair of old O'reenian Star Corps [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], resembling the vessels that had attacked the transport, arrived and demanded the crew's surrender. After defeating the fighters, the group determined the point of origin of the enemy starships and traveled there.<ref name="Fool" />

=====Retrieval from a garrison=====
Deciding to revert out of hyperspace near the edge of the O'reen system, the group approached O'reen at a slow cruise speed to avoid detection. Entering sensor range of the planet, the crew observed the orbiting O'reenian battle [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and the small [[Battle group/Legends|assault group]] of numerous, antiquated [[Frigate/Legends|battle frigates]] and [[Repair barge/Legends|repair barges]] surrounding it, guessing at the purpose of the formation.<ref name="Fool" />

After landing on O'reen, the members of the ship's crew altered their appearance in order to blend in with the natives and eventually tracked the stolen cargo to the Orbital Deployment Center. The group successfully passed the city's guarded perimeter and bluffed its way past the guards posted at the entrance of the analysis center, where the individuals then located the tactical data core.<ref name="Fool" />

However, before the group could enact its plan to steal the tactical computer, the station's military [[Supervisor/Legends|supervisor]] entered the room, immediately seeing through the group's disguise. In the resulting [[Skirmish in the Orbital Deployment Center analysis station|shootout]], the supervisor and the researchers present were defeated. The individuals then loaded the data core onto a [[Cargo speeder/Legends|cargo speeder]] before leaving the Orbital Deployment Center for their starship under the guise of transporting the computer to Fort Maximus. Finally, after avoiding the [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ships]] orbiting O'reen, the group left the system to return the computer to Amalia.<ref name="Fool" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|O'reenian}}
[[File:OreenArmedResearchers-TUR.jpg|thumb|right|230px|O'reen was inhabited by the near-Human O'reenians.]]
Ninety-eight percent of the O'reen population consisted of the O'reenians, a [[near-Human]] species that [[Language/Legends|spoke]] a [[O'reenian language|language]] derived from a very old dialect of [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]]. The O'reenian society was based on a system of castes and governed itself through a military dictatorship, headed by a single military leader, the Magnus.<ref name="TUR" />

Only those O'reenians who served with the planet's military for at least six years were granted full citizenship. Those who did not serve with the armed forces were termed "civilians," given few rights, and often forced to work in menial jobs commonly assigned to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the wider galaxy. Any visiting offworlders were automatically treated as civilians unless they proved they served with another's military or enlisted with that of O'reen.<ref name="TUR" />

On several occasions, the civilians of O'reen staged uprisings against the reigning order, but such insurrections were always brutally put down. Criminals on O'reen were rare and few in number and frequently flew their vehicles through the fog blanketing the planet's surface, navigating by their sensors alone. Such method of travel allowed the lawbreakers to hide from the authorities but was also dangerous due to the high risk of collisions with the walls of O'reen's mesas and plateaus.<ref name="TUR" />

As a result of the stringent social system, every citizen on O'reen was a capable combatant. Such discipline, combined with the continuous efforts of the planet's military to keep up with the combat technology level of the rest of the galaxy, allowed O'reen to become a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] comparable with those of the Galactic Empire in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Locations==
===Orbital Deployment Center===
{{Main|Orbital Deployment Center}}
Most of the numerous O'reenian cities, known as garrison-cities, were built atop the planet's mesas and plateaus. One of the oldest such settlements was the Orbital Deployment Center, which also served as the closest thing the planet had to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Any captured offworld military technology was stored and analyzed in the Orbital Deployment Center. An analysis station located just inside the outermost perimeter of the city was used for such studies.<ref name="TUR" />

However, the primary purpose of the Orbital Deployment Center was to use the planet's orbital satellites to monitor activity throughout the O'reen system. Over time, the satellites gained another function, as they were used to evaluate any potential targets for supply acquisition raids in the nearby [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. In addition to the surveillance satellites in O'reen's orbit, the entire planet was surrounded by a dense net of [[Space mine/Legends|orbital defense mines]] that detected, approached, and detonated in the vicinity of any starships moving toward the planet without transmitting the appropriate [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder identifiers]].<ref name="TUR" />

===Other cities===
Fort Maximus was both the capital of O'reen and its primary military headquarters. It was one of the most heavily fortified cities on the planet, with multiple defenses allowing the settlement to withstand a years-long siege. The [[Magnus's estate|estate]] of the ruling Magnus was located in the center of the city.<ref name="TUR" />

The city of [[Epsilon Garrison]] had a strong agricultural industry, and it contributed a significant portion of the crops consumed by the neighboring garrisons. The agricultural output of Epsilon Garrison was also used to support the standing armed forces stationed at Fort Maximus. In addition, Epsilon Garrison had the appearance of a military base despite not being as heavily fortified as the planet's capital. Uniquely from the other O'reen cities, Epsilon Garrison housed a substantial population of O'reenian civilians contemplating a global revolution aimed at improving the lives of all civilians on the planet.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Publication history===
O'reen was introduced in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2010]].<ref name="TUR" /> In the book, the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure "[[A Fool's Charge]]" erroneously states that the Republic outpost on O'reen was established after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="Fool" /> whereas the book's section detailing O'reen establishes it to have been colonized after the Great Hyperspace War instead.<ref name="TUR" /> The [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the O'reen system, and therefore the planet O'reen, in grid square H-13.<ref name="EAOC" />

===Roleplaying game options===
[[File:TheUnknownRegions.jpg|thumb|right|240px|''The Unknown Regions'' allows players to use O'reen as a setting with the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game''.]]
Within ''The Unknown Regions'', O'reen is mentioned in several adventure seeds for use with the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game''<ref name="TUR" /> and also appears in the mini-adventure "A Fool's Charge." This article assumes all of those scenarios play out as described. In "A Fool's Charge," the player characters are presented with several options for how to determine the exact coordinates of O'reen.<ref name="Fool" />

Firstly, the characters can attempt to reverse-calculate the hyperspatial trajectories of the O'reenian starfighters, using their own [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] charts to pinpoint the origin point of the craft. Secondly, an attempt can be made to salvage a [[Flight computer/Legends|flight computer]] from the fighter's wreckage, which can then be connected to either the characters' starship's onboard computer or a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], providing O'reen's location, clearance codes necessary for an approach to the planet, and evidence of O'reen having an active orbital patrol. Thirdly, if at least one of the enemy fighters was left intact, the characters can rescue [[Unidentified O'reenian pilot|one]] of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and convince him to reveal the necessary information.<ref name="Fool" />

Once the characters have discovered the location of O'reen, they are again provided with options for how to approach and land on the heavily guarded and militarized planet. The characters can emerge from hyperspace as close within the orbit of O'reen as possible, risking a dangerously close approach to the planet's [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]] for a tactical advantage. If the characters approach O'reen from a further distance, they can avoid the orbiting patrol ships in one of three suggested ways: They can simply outmaneuver and outrun the patrol vessels, risking the entire planet becoming alerted to their presence; they can locate and inconspicuously use an approach vector not covered by the flight patterns and the sensors of the patrol ships; or, if the characters previously learned O'reenian clearance codes, they can simply transmit them and land on the planet unhindered.<ref name="Fool" />
